verified.title: Cyberpunk 2077

game_settings.why: Cyberpunk 2.5: DLSS upscaling and DLSS frame-generation input to XeFG. Keep the game's own libxess.dll and disable XeSS upscaler input. This combination passed with HelixSR; native XeSS FG with DLSS/HelixSR did not generate in these checks. Native AMD Anti-Lag 2 is disabled for this DLSS route, matching the working FG profile. Reflex is enabled, matching the game's DLSS FG behavior without adding a frame-rate cap. With HelixSR, disable the reactive/bias mask input as a workaround for intermittent first-frame GPU faults; this removes a temporal-reconstruction input. Switching to FSR 4 returns this recipe-owned setting to its original value. Explicit user settings are preserved.

verified.note: Cyberpunk 2.5: DLSS upscaling and DLSS frame-generation input to XeFG. Keep the game's own libxess.dll and disable XeSS upscaler input. This combination passed with HelixSR; native XeSS FG with DLSS/HelixSR did not generate in these checks. Native AMD Anti-Lag 2 is disabled for this DLSS route, matching the working FG profile. Reflex is enabled, matching the game's DLSS FG behavior without adding a frame-rate cap. With HelixSR, disable the reactive/bias mask input as a workaround for intermittent first-frame GPU faults; this removes a temporal-reconstruction input. Switching to FSR 4 returns this recipe-owned setting to its original value. Explicit user settings are preserved. HLX FSR 4 HDR also requires the tested reactive-mask-off workaround: the default produced a GPU page fault during startup. This changes an upscaler input; mask-on quality equivalence is unqualified.
verified.observed: 2.5 benchmark, HelixSR Quality, DLSS FG input: 2.0 in SDR and HDR10
